question: The Hazira–Vijaipur–Jagdishpur (HVJ) pipeline is mainly used to transport:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Natural Gas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) pipeline** is one of the largest natural gas pipelines in India.
 
• The pipeline primarily serves to transport **natural gas** from the gas fields located in **Hazira, Gujarat**, to various destinations in northern and western parts of India, including **Vijaipur** in Madhya Pradesh and **Jagdishpur** in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• This pipeline was commissioned in **1986** and is operated by **GAIL (Gas Authority of India Limited)**.
 
• The HVJ pipeline has played a crucial role in reducing India's dependency on oil by encouraging the usage of **natural gas**, which is a cleaner and more environmentally friendly fuel source.
 
• It supports various sectors such as **power generation, fertilizer production, and industrial applications** by providing a steady supply of natural gas.
 
• The pipeline infrastructure is approximately **1750 km long**, making it one of the largest pipelines in the world for natural gas transportation.
 
• The HVJ pipeline also supports the Indian government's mission to promote cleaner energy alternatives and reduce carbon emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Petrol**__

 __
 
• **Petrol**, also known as gasoline, is a derivative of **crude oil** that is widely used as a fuel in internal combustion engines.
 
• It is not transported via the HVJ pipeline, as it is mainly transported through specialized tanker trucks, trains, or dedicated liquid pipelines.
 
• Petrol is highly flammable and used primarily as a fuel for vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Crude Oil**__
 __
 
• **Crude oil** is a naturally occurring liquid fossil fuel found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface.
 
• It is processed in refineries to produce a variety of products, including petrol, diesel, kerosene, and other petrochemicals.
 
• Crude oil is transported through pipelines, tankers, or by rail, but the HVJ pipeline is not designed for crude oil transportation.
 
 
 
• **Kerosene**__
 
 
• **Kerosene** is a liquid fuel derived from the distillation of petroleum and is commonly used for cooking, lighting, and as jet fuel.
 
• It is not transported through the HVJ pipeline, as the pipeline is specifically designed for the transportation of natural gas.
